title: Skincare after electrolysis
text:
Title pretty much sums it up! 

Previously I’ve been going to electrolysis for years because of my PCOS induced hormonal facial hair but this is the first time in a long time I’m doing a touch up on some new growth. I have normal skin which loooves moisture. In the past I’ve had a very simplified skincare and pretty much only used moisturizer on my face (I was so uninformed, yikes!) so I was wondering how to best treat my skin after the procedure and which products to leave out of rotation and for how long. The areas I’m getting done are my top lip and jaw area. In the past I’ve had red spots arise for a few days and most often the worst marks are done in a week. 

Listing all my products - I switch out AM/PM as I’ve seen my skin needs but it includes a combination of these: 
* Whamisa Deep Rich Toner 
* Novexpert Vitamin C Booster
* COSRX Advanced 96 Snail Mucin
* Nuxe Super Serum 10
* Clarins Double Serum Eye
* Murad Hydro-Dynamic Ultimate Moisture Moisturizer
* SPF 50
* Laneige Cica Sleeping Mask
*Drunk Elephant Virgin Marula Oil

No retinol products as we’re TTC so I haven’t started on those. I’m hoping that once we’ve had all our kids I can start retinol and it can help with my existing light scars under my chin.
